title: ExtCinematography
description: The ext-cinematography extension, version 0.2 (proposed). Everything rides under the namespaced 'ext-cinematography' key on entities: the 'camera' component makes an entity a camera, the 'shot' component makes it a setup in the shot list. The core schema leaves room for the key (unknown fields are allowed and must-ignored); this schema pins the extension's own shape. Spec: spec/extensions/cinematography.md.

CameraComponent.description: An entity's ext-cinematography camera: a filmback and a lens. Defaults apply per absent field, so an empty object is a 35 mm lens on Super 35 looking down the entity's local -Z.

sensor_mm.description: Sensor (filmback) size [w, h] in millimeters. Default Super 35.

aspect_ratio.description: The frame's width/height. The frame is the largest rectangle of this aspect inside the desqueezed sensor, centred; absent means the whole desqueezed sensor.

squeeze.description: Anamorphic squeeze factor; the desqueezed sensor is sensor_mm[0] * squeeze wide.

aim.description: A world point the camera looks at, +Y up. Absent: the camera looks down the entity's local -Z.

ShotComponent.description: An entity's ext-cinematography shot: the camera as a setup in the shot list. The entity's name is the shot's name.

order.description: Shot list sort key; ties break by entity id.

in_s.description: Setup start on the clock, seconds; <= out_s.

out_s.description: Setup end on the clock, seconds.

size.description: Shot size, free text; conventionally EWS, WS, MS, MCU, CU, ECU, INSERT, OTS, POV, TWO.

description.description: What the setup is, free text.

EntityBlock.description: The entity's ext-cinematography block: a camera, optionally also a shot.
